svg.title: OpenBot: your workspace, your stack
svg.desc: An exploded stack with an OpenBot workspace, Built-in Bots or any agent connected through AG-UI and A2A, your models, MCP tools, modular lanes for MCP hubs (Composio, Arcade, AgentCore), sandboxes (Daytona, E2B, Modal, your Kubernetes), agent runtimes, vaults, and more, and your infrastructure or OpenBot Cloud. Deploy on a laptop or Kubernetes with Helm. The workspace provides enterprise governance and controls.

g.text: Great defaults, or plug in your own
AWS · Azure · Google Cloud · OpenBot Cloud
